---
name: repo-status-badge
description: Assign or update repository maturity badges from explicit engineering evidence. Use when a project changes incubation beta flagship or production-readiness status. Do not use when the requested label cannot be supported by repository tests CI security and release evidence.
---

# Repository status badge

- Inspect the target repository evidence before changing a status label.
- Treat flagship priority and production readiness as separate dimensions.
- Require the engineering gates documented by Ventura Studio for any production-grade claim.
- Keep incubation or experimental labels when implementation evidence is incomplete.
- Update the visible badge and nearby explanatory text together.
- Avoid numeric quality claims without reproducible metrics.
- Verify links and repository checks after editing.
